points.summary: Advocate for expanded counseling and advising, basic needs programs (food, housing, childcare), clear and transparent degree and transfer pathways, and career/technical education aligned with the regional job market to help students succeed from first day to finish.

points.summary: Review budget decisions with focus on student outcomes rather than administrative convenience, support open and accessible financial reporting for the community, ask hard questions about long-term sustainability before major expenditures, and ensure bond and grant funds are tracked with full transparency.

points.summary: Hold regular community listening sessions in Area 3, strengthen partnerships with Gilroy Unified School District for high-school-to-college transition, support outreach to first-generation college students, and ensure board meetings and communications are accessible in language, format, and timing.

points.summary: Support programs connecting students to internships, apprenticeships, and local employers; advocate for workforce programs serving adults returning to school or changing careers; work with regional employers to keep programs current; ensure certificate and degree programs lead to living-wage jobs.

points.summary: Commit to coming prepared to every board meeting, maintaining clear boundaries between board oversight and day-to-day administration, fostering a culture of respectful debate and shared accountability, and reporting back to Area 3 constituents regularly rather than only at election time.
